title: Pipedrive vs Zoho: Focused CRM vs Broader Business Suite
description: A practical decision guide to Pipedrive and Zoho. Pipedrive supports manage sales pipelines and deal follow-up; Zoho may cover offer a broader business application suite with CRM among its possible workflows. Confirm the exact product/module, current plan, workflow fit, integrations, data ownership, and total cost before deciding. No universal winner is claimed without a current, controlled benchmark.

verdict: Pipedrive and Zoho should be compared against the workflow they are expected to support, not by historical star ratings or unverified price claims. Manage sales pipelines and deal follow-up and offer a broader business application suite with CRM among its possible workflows can require different operating models. Run a pilot with written acceptance criteria, verify current vendor documentation, and record implementation, integration, governance, and renewal costs.

faqs.question: What is the main difference between Pipedrive and Zoho?
faqs.answer: Pipedrive is evaluated for manage sales pipelines and deal follow-up; Zoho is evaluated for offer a broader business application suite with CRM among its possible workflows. For a broader suite, specify the exact product and module rather than assuming every feature is part of one plan.

faqs.question: Can Pipedrive replace Zoho?
faqs.answer: Do not assume so. List the exact workflows, records, controls, reports, and integrations required, then test each product against the same acceptance criteria.

faqs.question: Can both products be used together?
faqs.answer: Potentially, if each serves a distinct role. Define which system owns each data field and process step, how records synchronize, how duplicates are resolved, and who maintains the integration.

faqs.question: How should I compare their pricing?
faqs.answer: Use current vendor quotes for the same workload. Include seats, usage limits, add-ons, required modules, implementation, integration work, training, administration, support, and renewal terms.

faqs.question: What should I test before choosing?
faqs.answer: Use realistic sample data and document task completion, missing capabilities, reporting, permissions, export options, migration effort, and ongoing operating cost.
